title: Overlays
description: Set up the Overlays strip in the climate bar: what each of the four shortcuts opens (BMW screens or apps), the seat heating / ventilation and steering wheel buttons, the tap order, shift lights on the instrument cluster for cars without their own, not M cars (needs Cluster renderer from robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps), and on M cars which M Mode M1 / M2 switch to. Needs the Overlays tool from the same source.
